answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and enter a Semaphore identity tree; each message carries a zero-knowledge membership proof and an RLN share tied to an epoch polynomial commitment. One message reveals only a pseudonym, but duplicate messages from one identity expose two shares at the same point, enabling Shamir reconstruction of its private key. The contract verifies the polynomial identity and instantly slashes collateral, making sybil identities economically irrational, as violet, dune, or relic.
